points: Tablets can now be placed into the Map Device to add their bonuses directly to your Map.
Up to 3 Tablets per Map; slots available depend on how many modifiers the Map has; 6 modifiers enable all 3.
Tablets now have a maximum of 4 modifiers.
Crafting beyond 2 modifiers required defeating the Arbiter of Ash (superseded in 0.5 by the Reverse Transcription / Partial Translation passives).
Generic Precursor Tablet modifiers can roll on all tablet base types; 'Plundering' item quantity modifier disabled.
Temple Precursor Tablets added (guarantee Vaal Beacons).
Tablets of the same type may be used together to increase the amount of league content spawned.
Each empty tablet slot contributes to the amount of random non-tablet league content.
Orbs of Chance usable on Tablets; Irradiated (basic) and Overseer tablets require Atlas specialisation.
Tablets cannot be used on maps that cannot have extra content; league tablets no longer drop from non-map areas.
General tablet modifier values aligned with waystone modifiers; roll variance reduced.
Forgotten By Time temporarily disabled from dropping.
Jado's Partial Translations now: randomly gain 0-40% increased effect of explicit modifiers on tablets.
Delirium fog scaling halved; Delirium tablets now scale fog effect, three tablets = previous value.
Close to the Surface extended to Abyssal Depths; City Biome: Tablet Effect passives fixed.
More than one Ritual Tablet adds an extra Altar and more Azmeri Wisps in the Viridian Wildwood.
Expedition Tablets drop in Standard and Forbidden Rites (not Runes of Aldur); 1-4 tablet breakpoints; new Expedition modifiers.
'of the Invasion' now 1-2 additional rares (was 1-3); 'of Champions' now 2-3 (was 1-2).
Increased the droprate of Expedition, Temple & Delirium Tablets.

notes: Each waystone mod = difficulty part + one reward type (monster effectiveness / item rarity / pack size / monster rarity) + waystone drop chance; reward parts identical across low/mid/top tier pools, only difficulty scales.
Top tier pool: 27 normal mods, 19 desecrated mods (11 Abyss prefixes 'of the Abyss' + 8 suffixes); desecrated via Preserved Vertebrae (遗存椎骨).
Omens: 混沌稀有/数量/怪物/效能预兆 make the next Chaos Orb reroll into mods NOT of item rarity / pack size / monster rarity / effectiveness; up to 3 at once (0.5.0).
Citadels (古铜/钢铁/磐石城塞) need T15+; higher waystone drop chance gives a chance for extra crisis fragments (poe2db text).
Waystone tier N area level = 64 + N (T15 = 79, T16 = 80); 3 waystones of tier N reforge into 1 of tier N+1.
